??? quote "Dialogue"

    - In or out, dear, do not hover in the doorway, it lets the heat out and the smoke in. Hungry? Of course you are. Everyone who comes through that door is hungry or arguing, usually both.
    - There you are. You washed your bowl last time without being told. I remember that. Sit; the pot is on, the pot is always on.
    - Table night, and a big one. They will argue about that door till dawn and eat the pot to the bottom doing it. Bastian has two speeches. I have heard both. Twice. Eat something before you go in.
    - Look up. Go on, look. You can see the ceiling. I had forgotten it was painted. Margo's grate sparks, Bastian's bellows wheezes, and the smoke goes up the flue like it was told to. I cried, and for once it was not the onions.
    - Well? What is it?
        - *Choice:* Tell me about the pot.
        - *Choice:* How did you end up married to Bastian?
        - *Choice:* Are the carts still coming?
        - *Choice:* Nothing, thanks.
    - My grandmother, Bettany Ferrow, cooked for the Table nearly forty years in this kitchen, and she never let this pot go empty. Each night you add what there is, each night the Table eats most of it, each morning you start again on what is left.
    - When her knees went, she sat by the fire and gave me orders for four more years. I still talk to the pot as if she were listening. Some say they can taste a hundred years of arguments in it. That is the pepper.
    - He spent a whole winter standing up at the Table in the middle of debates about drains and lamp oil to say how good my stew was. Every session. In front of everyone.
    - I married him to stop him talking about it. It did not work. He tries every new speech on me while I stir, and when he changes his mind I am the first to hear. I would not have it any other way. Do not tell him I said so.
    - Fewer every season. The farm carts, the meat carts, all late or not at all. More and more of what goes in that pot grows on a roof now, in Old Parsnip's tubs.
    - A pot that has never been emptied takes a great deal of feeding. It will not be empty on my watch. But I lie awake about it some nights, and I am not a woman who lies awake.
    - Off you go. And the bowl goes back on the shelf, clean, or I will know.
